data.one_liner: Run local LLMs, vision, embeddings, RAG, tool calling, STT, and TTS on mobile and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to run large language models, vision models, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice activity detection completely offline and on-device using GGUF and ONNX models with Metal/Vulkan acceleration.
use_when: You need offline and on-device AI inference without relying on cloud APIs.
Your app needs local RAG, semantic search, or tool calling capabilities.
You want to process speech-to-text or text-to-speech locally within the app.
avoid_when: You target low-end devices with limited RAM that cannot handle model sizes.
You want to keep your application binary size extremely small.
strengths: Runs completely offline with no API keys required.
Supports text, vision, audio, embeddings, RAG, and tool calling in one library.
Hardware acceleration via Metal and Vulkan.
weaknesses: Large model sizes significantly increase app download or memory footprints.
Performance depends heavily on the user's device specs and available RAM.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the engine via nobodywho.NobodyWho.init() in main.dart and provide local or downloaded GGUF/ONNX models.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight Dart-focused solution for running llama.cpp models.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer deploying TensorFlow Lite models for custom ML tasks.
